title: Unveiling the antioxidant potential of a Laetiporus sulphureus peptide fraction: from Nrf2/HO-1-mediated cytoprotection to in silico screening of novel candidates.
authors: He, Jiyuan; Chen, Huilin; Wei, Zhaonan; Xu, Yuxin; Liu, Shengrong; Wei, Qi; Fang, Ting
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌肽段的抗氧化活性及Nrf2/HO-1通路保护作用，仅涉及小肽与蛋白的虚拟筛选，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A peptide fraction (A1) with molecular weight < 10 kDa was prepared from Laetiporus sulphureus via enzymatic hydrolysis and ultrafiltration. A1, primarily containing low-molecular-weight peptides (63.59% <5 kDa, 49.63% <3 kDa), exhibited strong in vitro antioxidant activity. In H(2)O(2)-injured CAL-27 cells, A1 reduced reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, restored mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP). Furthermore, it further activated the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway, leading to increased activities of the superoxide dismutase (SOD) and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px), thereby protecting against oxidative damage. It also promoted cell migration and wound closure. Peptidomic analysis identified 1857 peptides, predominantly 3-7 amino acids long. Five novel tripeptides (MRF, RMF, PRW, RMW, and MDW) showed high binding affinity to Nrf2/HO-1 pathway proteins in silico. These findings demonstrate the antioxidant and cytoprotective potential of L. sulphureus peptides as functional food components against oxidative stress.
abstract_zh: 通过酶解和超滤从硫磺菌（Laetiporus sulphureus）中制备了分子量<10 kDa的肽组分（A1）。A1主要含有低分子量肽（63.59% <5 kDa，49.63% <3 kDa），表现出较强的体外抗氧化活性。在H(2)O(2)损伤的CAL-27细胞中，A1降低了活性氧（ROS）水平，恢复了线粒体膜电位（MMP）。此外，它进一步激活了Nrf2/HO-1通路，导致超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GSH-Px）活性增加，从而保护细胞免受氧化损伤。它还促进了细胞迁移和伤口愈合。肽组学分析鉴定出1857种肽，主要为3-7个氨基酸长度。五种新型三肽（MRF、RMF、PRW、RMW和MDW）在计算机模拟中显示出对Nrf2/HO-1通路蛋白的高结合亲和力。这些发现表明，硫磺菌肽作为功能性食品成分，具有对抗氧化应激的抗氧化和细胞保护潜力。
